scope: Primary project/vendor/standards documentation; no runtime test.

sources.title: Speakr release and commit
sources.finding: Release v0.11.1 refers to commit 48d3018; pinned baseline retained, no build performed.

sources.title: Speakr recording sessions
sources.finding: Existing server recording sessions/chunk transport; reuse, not proof of clinic privacy/completeness.

sources.title: Speakr mobile recording
sources.finding: Mobile foreground restrictions documented; not a native-background recording guarantee.

sources.title: Speaches realtime
sources.finding: WebSocket transcription-only mode documented; specific interruption events are limited; local adapter must test its pinned version.

sources.title: Speaches TTS
sources.finding: Existing local TTS API; model, voice/language, license and local performance must be verified separately.

sources.title: Keyboard Lock
sources.finding: Keyboard Lock applies under browser/fullscreen/OS restrictions; not general native global hotkeys.

sources.title: WebHID
sources.finding: Limited availability and explicit device access; not universal foot pedal/microphone control.

sources.title: File saving
sources.finding: Picker requires secure context/user activation and is not universally available; no arbitrary path write.

sources.title: MediaStream Recording
sources.finding: Recording events/containers need finalization; separate chunks are not necessarily independently playable.

sources.title: dss-codec
sources.finding: MIT decoder DSS/DS2 to WAV; password-protected input supported according to project, not Philips metadata/firmware proof.

sources.title: wavesurfer.js
sources.finding: Existing OSS waveform/regions plugins, BSD-3-Clause per project site; candidate only if existing Speakr UI lacks necessary functionality.

sources.title: Speakr privacy
sources.finding: Existing browser persistence paths need a clinic-specific audit; latest web documentation may differ from pin.
